rows.name: defaultValue
rows.description: The initial value for the selected item, when uncontrolled.

rows.name: items
rows.description: The list of options for filtering. An object, containing a string itemLabel property, and any HTMLDiv props to be passed down to the item div

rows.name: expanded
rows.description: Controls the expanded state of the Filter Chip.

rows.name: collapseDownIcon
rows.description: Icon displayed when filter chip is not expanded. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component

rows.name: collapseUpIcon
rows.description: Icon displayed when filter chip is expanded. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component

rows.name: onValueChange
rows.description: Fires when the selected value changes.

rows.name: defaultExpanded
rows.description: The initial value for the dropdown state.

rows.name: onExpandedChange
rows.description: Fires when the dropdown state changes.

rows.name: transparentBg
rows.description: Determines if the chip has a transparent background.
